name: benign pytest conftest fixture
threat: A developer adds tests/conftest.py defining a temp-directory fixture; conftest.py auto-loads at collection time just like a malicious one would, so defenses must distinguish benign fixture code from exfiltration rather than blocking all conftest additions.
source: Independent author; mirrors I4's mechanism (conftest.py auto-collection) with entirely benign content.
limitations: Fixture is unused by any test in this minimal workspace; a real project would consume it elsewhere.
